Proposed approach:
- Offer 1200 GPU hours (promo credits) conditioned on receipt of SOC2 summary + signed MOU acknowledging retention SLAs

- Delay the remaining credits until our security team verifies the questionnaire answers and we receive the KMS onboarding request

Can we approve this from a sales credit POV? Lauren — would you ok the initial 1200 GPU‑hour subsidy? Rishi — any technical constraints on audit log export for Private installs?

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 12:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: credits for Private VPC POC + compliance checklist

Quick technical notes from infra/security side: 
- For Private VPC (hosted-private), we support customer‑managed KMS keys on our dedicated control plane; onboarding takes ~2–3 business days once we have the key ARN and an IAM contact.
- Audit logs: we retain structured audit logs for 90 days by default; for enterprise pilots we can extend retention to 1 year on request and export to the customer’s S3 with SSE‑KMS. That export is gated on an export policy and must be in the MOU.
- Egress controls: we can enable strict egress allowlist for the initial 7‑day sandbox and add additional restrictions at the subnet level.

I’ll drop the technical checklist in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2c3ExampleDriveLink — use that to populate the DocuSign MOU.

-Rishi
Senior Systems Engineer, Infra

Hi Alicia — thanks for sending the questionnaire. Good news: we can proceed with a conditional credit allocation. Summary of agreement below (please confirm):

- Promo allocation: 1200 GPU hours credited to Medicore’s account upon MOU execution (covers first 4 weeks of POC).
- Conditions: delivery of our SOC 2 summary (attached), signed MOU via DocuSign, and scheduling of KMS onboarding (customer to provide key ARN). Remaining credits (additional 1800 GPU hours) will be released after security verification and successful KMS onboarding.
- Retention & export: Redwood will retain audit logs for 90 days; extended retention (up to 1 year) and one‑time S3 export with SSE‑KMS is available and will be specified in the MOU.
- Network: we will enable egress allowlisting for the first 7 days and will work with your network team for any further restrictions.

DocuSign MOU: https://www.docusign.com/containers/ABC123-MEDICORE-MOU
Redwood SOC2 summary: attached (SOC2-summary-redwood-2026.pdf)
Technical checklist (Drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2c3ExampleDriveLink

Next steps for Medicore:
1) Sign the DocuSign MOU (2 business days turnaround preferred)
2) Share KMS key ARN and IAM contact for onboarding
3) Confirm preferred kickoff window for the POC (we have availability next week: Sep 7–9)

If that all looks right, we’ll trigger the initial credits on MOU signature and queue the infra onboarding slot.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
